strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ Ou POU ganny sinyen sorti dan Google kont (ou bezwen re-azout zot). untouched.
• Sa laparey i relans otomatikman apre.

Eski ou asire?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: tyek sa keybox aktyel kont lalis revokasyon Google (CRL) e esey plizyer sours ziska ler i trouv en keybox valid, avek en backup otomatik e en relansman bann servis Google. i mars lo sak tap e i bezwen enternet (1-3 minit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: telesarz en keybox sorti dan repozitwar ofisyel (GitHub) e prezerv li lo /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. I bezwen enternet e i pran 1-3 minit. servi ler smart fetch i fel oubyen ler keybox in ganny sanze mannyelman.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: tyek bann modil provizyon lakle a zistans ki disponib, enspekte TEE versyon sertifika atestasyon, e montre leta zouti KmInstallKeybox. pa sanz nanryen — en vi stati laparey senp.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): i montre Widevine bann endikater nivo (L1/L3) sorti kot dumpsys, prezans dosye lakle DRM (IDM), e bann propriyete sistenm relye. pa modifye nanryen ditou.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. aranz bann problenm atestasyon ler pas otomatik i fel. sak tay i enprim en laliny sikse/defet kler.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. i okip bann ka difisil e i pran plis letan. en rezilta kler i aparet alafen.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: i retir Play Store ek Google servis (GMS+GSF) data e relans sa laparey otomatikman. zis pou bann atestasyon teti — i pa zanmen tous ou bann portre oubyen dosye.
strings.mdCertify: • Sertifikasyon zwe: tyek leta atestasyon sertifika RKP lo laparey e reset bann propriyete atestasyon si i neseser. pa tous lenformasyon itilizater.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER reparasyon: aranz Google kad servis (SOTER) bann problenm relye avek atestasyon laparey. servi pou serten laparey ki depan lo SOTER olye Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. aplik lanprint selekte (lokal/avanse) e met azour bann dosye pif.prop/pif.json. en rezilta kler i aparet dan rezis.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF tyeke: i montre leta moter enstale, bann dosye lanprint (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), e bann rezis. tyek selman — i pa modifye nanryen.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. rod dernyen version Canary Engine pou asir konpatibilite avek bann sertifika RKP mandatwar (Fevriye 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Dyagnostik moter: tyek leta TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), bann dosye bwat lakle (aktiv vs itilizater), lanprent laparey reel vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP lakle. Afis dyagnostik selman.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 bann plas dan bwat lakle (primer / segonder)
strings.hintKbSlots: sa modil i zer de plas dan bwat lakle: sa enn primer (sakre, pa'n zanmen ganny efase) e sa enn segonder (backup). sa tab i montre ki slot i aktiv, sanz preferans, oubyen promot segonder pour primer lo demann eksplisit — avek bann backup ek en rezis konplet.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Dyagnostik lentegrite: tyek lenportasyon lakle TEE, linjeksyon bibliotek anndan keystore2, stati revokasyon (CRL), kouvertir lalis proteksyon e leta RKP. lir selman — i pa sanz nanryen.

_ relanse.

Napa nanryen ki'n ganny efase e bwat lakle prensipal pa'n zanmen ganny touse.

Kontinyen?
